items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The diff removes only the obsolete runtime verifier surface and leaves dev_server and external WebUI code unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: The retired selector now fails through argparse's explicit invalid-choice path while surviving selectors still import and dispatch.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Removal eliminates interpretation of stale or attacker-controlled legacy PID-file data and adds no input surface.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: The CLI integration test failed on both acceptance dimensions before the fix and passes after it; 76 targeted remaining-verifier tests also pass.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The change removes process probes and adds no runtime work.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The durable regression is the general test_verify_phase_cli.py contract, and the ordered phase tuple is named alongside the existing dispatcher.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The deleted producer/consumer pair is documented; a round trip is structurally impossible because no producer remains, and the real CLI retirement boundary is integration-tested.
